briefings.title: The Hormuz shock, AI and China: the state of global energy, with Jason Bordoff

people.name: Jason Bordoff
people.role: Director, Center on Global Energy Policy

people.name: Roberto Booca
people.role: Head of the Centre for Energy and Materials, World Economic Forum

briefings.tldr: Despite the Strait of Hormuz closure being the largest oil supply disruption in history, global energy markets showed unexpected resilience due to shifting Chinese demand and high inventories; however, the transition to clean energy now faces critical "headwinds" caused by geopolitical fragmentation and the difficulty of de-risking dependence on Chinese supply chains.
